messages:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — AcmeHealth sent the vendor risk form. They specifically flagged 'access reviews' and 'key lifecycle'. Can someone paste our standard reply or point me to the canonical doc? cc @ashwin_eng @maria_security

ashwin_eng: We normally say: quarterly access reviews, automated offboarding hooks tied to SCIM, owners attest in 72h. KMS keys are customer-isolated when on Private; for Hosted we use KMS with envelope encryption. I'll paste suggested blurb.

ashwin_eng: ```Access review cadence: Quarterly. Process: App owners receive a list of active principals; attest or remove within 5 business days. Offboarding automation: SCIM + webhook removes app/service accounts within 24 hours of deactivation.```

maria_security: For key lifecycle: rotation policy = annually for master CMKs, per-model per-deployment rotation on request. We should also mention key access logging in CloudAudit and that log exports retained 90 days by default.

katie_onb: Also call out MFA for console/API access and principle of least privilege. Our onboarding checklist has the sample attestation email — I can drop it into the thread.

elaine_cs: Perfect — can someone approve this copy for me to send? I want something concise to paste into their form.

ashwin_eng: Approved. Slight tweak: change '5 business days' to '7 business days' to match SLAs. Also add link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/access-reviews

maria_security: Approved from security. Add: 'keys are AES-256 with envelope encryption; HSM-backed CMKs where requested.'

elaine_cs: Thanks all — sending now. Will post the response here once they reply :thumbsup:
